text: 香港财政司司长陈茂波8月2日发表司长随笔称，本港今年上半年经济增长为5.1%，较预期强劲。下半年商品出口料继续受惠全球对人工智能产品的强大需求；境外对本港金融及商业服务的需求持续，以及访港旅客的增加，均将带动服务输出增长，有利本地消费和投资气氛。综合考虑整体经济发展情况，本月中发表的经修订全年经济增长预测，将从原先预测的范围向上调整，惟未来走势仍受地缘政治局势发展、美息及其他不确定因素影响。我们将继续保持高度警惕，既大力加快发展经济，也守稳经济金融安全。
text_en: Hong Kong Financial Secretary Paul Chan said in his blog on Aug 2 that Hong Kong's economy grew 5.1% in the first half, stronger than expected. In H2, merchandise exports are expected to continue benefiting from strong global demand for AI products; sustained external demand for Hong Kong's financial and business services, along with more visitor arrivals, will drive services export growth, supporting local consumption and investment sentiment. Given overall economic conditions, the revised full-year growth forecast to be released this month will be raised from the original projected range, though the outlook remains subject to geopolitical developments, US interest rates, and other uncertainties. We will remain highly vigilant, vigorously accelerating economic development while safeguarding economic and financial security.
